verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a universal search bar in the Jeeves app spanning transactions, vendors, and cards, or a jump-to-payment action from search results. What it does document is adjacent and earns no credit: transaction-query API endpoints are developer building blocks, and the MCP server's filtering and vendor-management tools are a separate agent feature, not an in-app unified search.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can search across all transactions, vendors, and cards from one universal search bar and jump straight into initiating a payment
